admission.justification: Dismissal persistence and UI feedback are a maintained cross-boundary obligation: treating optimistic removal as successful durable acknowledgement silently loses failed clicks. Native action/queue targets and separate bulk/failure/source-defined ASGI assertions establish the bounded contract, not a Curator runtime grade.

applicability: Individual and Clear-all acknowledgement controls for actionable-drift, provider-down, failed-setup and blocked-start, through the native dismissal action and current queue presentation.
conditions: Requests use the current itemId and supported kind; Clear all composes per-item requests.
Presentation may optimistically hide a pending request; an unsuccessful reply restores that item and reports that the dismissal did not hold.
exclusions: Task/lifecycle/gate acceptance or dismissal of future occurrences.
An assertion that pending items are hidden only after success.
statement: Every remaining operational attention kind accepts individual/bulk dismissal, and a failed write leaves the item visible.
